_note: aog-baidu-3 is a near-duplicate of aog-baidu-2 from the same spot, kept out to avoid three copies of one facade.

aog-baidu-1.webp.zh: 鞍山腾鳌机场航站楼正面：楼顶立着红色「鞍山」字样与 An Shan 标识，广场上只有零星车辆。
aog-baidu-1.webp.en: The front of Anshan Teng'ao Airport's terminal — red '鞍山' characters and 'An Shan' lettering on the roof, an almost empty forecourt below.

aog-baidu-2.webp.zh: 航站楼近景：玻璃幕墙前的台阶与灯笼，左侧是圆形的塔台。
aog-baidu-2.webp.en: A closer view of the terminal — steps and lanterns before the glazed frontage, the round control tower to the left.

aog-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 蓝天之下，楼顶红色「鞍山」二字与An Shan字样醒目，塔台的玻璃室从屋后探出。
aog-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under a deep blue sky the terminal roof carries big red Anshan characters and 'An Shan' script, with the control tower's glazing showing behind.

aog-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 灰色航站楼入口前挂着红色横幅，一行人正沿台阶往里走，门厅上方是整排玻璃窗。
aog-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A red banner hangs over the grey terminal entrance while a group of people heads up the steps beneath rows of windows.

aog-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 地图截图：红色定位标落在鞍山市区以西，G15与G16高速及东部山地都清晰可辨。
aog-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A map screenshot drops a red pin just west of Anshan city, with the G15 and G16 expressways and the mountains to the east clearly legible.
